```yaml
name: Approve Workflows
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - labeled
      - synchronize
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Build and Push Release Images"
      - "Agentcube E2E Tests"
      - "Lint"
      - "Agentcube CI Workflow"

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'pending')
    steps:
      - name: Check if PR is from a fork
        id: check_fork
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}" != "${{ github.repository }}" ]]; then
            echo "fork=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "fork=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Get PR number
        id: get_pr
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request_target" ]]; then
            echo "pr_number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            echo "pr_number=${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check if PR has ok-to-test label
        id: check_label
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request_target" ]]; then
            if [[ "${{ github.event.label.name }}" == "ok-to-test" ]]; then
              echo "has_label=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "has_label=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          elif [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            # For workflow_run event, we need to fetch the PR to check labels
            PR_NUMBER="${{ steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number }}"
            LABELS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER" | jq -r '.labels[].name')
            if echo "$LABELS" | grep -q "ok-to-test"; then
              echo "has_label=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "has_label=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          fi

      - name: Check if contributor is returning
        id: check_contributor
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER="${{ steps.get_pr.outputs.pr_number }}"
          CREATOR="${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}"
          
          # Fetch all PRs by this creator
          PR_COUNT=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:${{ github.repository }}+author:${CREATOR}+type:pr" | jq -r '.total_count')
          
          if [[ $PR_COUNT -le 1 ]]; then
            echo "returning=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "returning=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Approve workflow run
        if: |
          (steps.check_label.outputs.has_label == 'true') ||
          (steps.check_contributor.outputs.returning == 'true')
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_run" ]]; then
            # Approve the workflow run
            curl -X POST \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/approve"
          fi
```
